name: carnot_engine_refrigerator
title: Carnot engine driving a Carnot refrigerator
summary: A Carnot heat engine between a 200 °C reservoir and 30 °C ambient drives a Carnot refrigerator that holds a cold space at -30 °C. The model computes the engine efficiency, the refrigerator COP and the ratio of the two heat transfers. No working fluid is solved.
